label: AI Agency / n8n Automation Studio
description: Control-room landing page for an AI-automation agency selling AI agents and n8n workflows: animated node-flow architecture demos, pain grid, solution stack, pricing tiers, and a conversion zone with a Cal.com booking embed plus a webhook-backed lead form.

blocks.name: hero
blocks.label: Hero with interactive n8n-style node flow

blocks.name: contact
blocks.label: Conversion zone — Cal.com embed + lead form

content.note: Content is a single typed source (content/site.ts), Russian only. Storyblok wiring (BlockProvider + delivery client + per-block schema) is tracked in TPL-2.

storyblok.note: TPL-2: define per-block Storyblok component schema to seed via the Management API.

backend.note: Feature layer is env-gated. With no feature this builds as a static export (output: export) and the lead form posts directly to NEXT_PUBLIC_N8N_WEBHOOK_URL. When a backend feature is on, the CLI sets EASYLAND_BACKEND=1 → output: standalone, enabling app/api (bookings, auth, and POST /api/leads which stores leads in MongoDB, emails the admin and forwards to N8N_WEBHOOK_URL) plus the /admin dashboard. Static clients have app/api + app/admin pruned at scaffold time.

integrations.calendar: Cal.com (or Calendly) embed — set NEXT_PUBLIC_CAL_LINK (e.g. "acme/30min") or NEXT_PUBLIC_CAL_EMBED_URL for any other provider.
integrations.leads: NEXT_PUBLIC_N8N_WEBHOOK_URL posts the form straight to an n8n Webhook node (works in static builds). Server-side N8N_WEBHOOK_URL forwards from /api/leads in backend builds.
